newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Dec 4.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Dec 4.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.

-- Chancellor Helmut Kohl and President Jacques Chirac to meet this evening to discuss European single currency, after European finance ministers fail to reach agreement on a future stability pact and criteria defining excessive budget deficits.
-- Paris prosecutor opens a criminal investigation into suspected fraud and issuance of misleading information at state bank Credit Lyonnais in the early 1990s.
-- Strike goes on at three Elf oil refineries against planned job cuts.

-- CFDT labour union says planned Thomson privatisation includes illegal aspects, notably that Thomson and Thomson Multimedia are to be sold separately, and calls for a specific assessment of Thomson Multimedia's value prior to sale.
